name: ternary
title: Ternary Diagram
description: Plots compositions of three components as a ternary diagram: a triangle with a grid, tick labels and corner names, drawn with ordinary traces so that colors, lines, markers, text and the legend can be changed in Modify Trace and the rest of the app afterwards.

actions.name: ternary
actions.title: Ternary Diagram
actions.description: Makes a ternary diagram of the points (a, b, c). Each point is scaled to a + b + c = 100 %, so fractions, percentages and amounts all work. A is at the top, B at the bottom right and C at the bottom left.

names.title: Names
names.description: The names written at the corners, top, bottom right and bottom left, separated by commas.

step.title: Grid step (%)
step.description: How far apart the grid lines and tick labels are.

ticks.title: Tick labels
ticks.description: Which side each component's values are written on. Clockwise: A on the left side, B on the right, C at the bottom; counterclockwise: A on the right, B at the bottom, C on the left.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: The points' text in a legend at the top right; empty, no legend.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: The shape of the points' markers.

marker_color.title: Marker color
marker_color.description: The color of the points: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a name such as red, blue or black.

marker_size.title: Marker size
marker_size.description: How large the points' markers are.

marker_fill.title: Filled markers
marker_fill.description: Whether the markers are filled, or drawn as outlines.

group.title: Group
group.description: A wave that names the group of each point, such as the crystal structure: text, or numbers. Each group is drawn with a marker and a color of its own and listed in the legend; marker and marker color are then not used. Points with an empty group are left out.

group_markers.title: Group markers
group_markers.description: The groups' markers, in the order the groups first appear, separated by commas ("circle, square"). Groups not given one take circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross and plus in turn.

group_colors.title: Group colors
group_colors.description: The groups' colors, in the same order, separated by commas ("red, blue" or "#d62728, #1f77b4"). Groups not given one take colors in turn.
